findings.title: Cleanup action uses literal alias instead of actual IDP alias
findings.body: The cleanup callback is created with `testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")` instead of the alias built for the IDP (e.g. `alias` variable or `"idp-alias-20"`). The same mistake appears for idp-alias-20 at line 425. None of the IDPs created in `testCacheIDPForLogin` are removed during cleanup, leaving up to 21 IDPs (and organization links) in the test realm. This can contaminate subsequent tests and cache assertions.

findings.title: Unconditional delegate fetch on IDP removal
findings.body: `idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias)` is now invoked before checking whether a valid cached `CachedIdentityProvider` is available. When the alias cache hit path is taken, the code already has the model in `cached.getIdentityProvider()` and uses it for `registerIDPInvalidation`; the extra delegate fetch adds a database read to every IDP removal. This can be avoided by using the cached model and falling back to the delegate only when the cache is invalid or missing.
